tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Total base length of focusing triangles meeting a unit interval] For every unit subarc $J\subset c_0$, the total length of maximal focusing bases meeting $J$ is at most $2\delta +\mu <0.03$. \end{claim}
Proof

↗ cor:focusing-triangle-base-bound-collection \sketch Each base has length at most $\delta +\mu $, so those meeting $J$ lie in an arc of length below two. Their total turning is at most $2\delta $ and the disjoint triangle areas total at most $\mu $.

□

Proposition
[Boundary length estimate for annuli of small area]
